question: Padayani is a folk dance from which state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Padayani** is a traditional folk dance that originated in the central** Travancore region** of **Kerala.**
 
• It is performed during the **annual festival of Onam** and is also associated with the worship of the goddess **Bhadrakali.**
 
• The dance is characterized by the use of **colorful masks** and elaborate headgear made of plantain leaves.
 
• The performers also wear** ankle bells** and carry decorated **sticks or swords **while dancing to the rhythm of drums and cymbals.
 
• The dance is believed to have originated as a **form of ritualistic worship **and has now become a popular cultural attraction in Kerala.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **state of Karnataka **has several traditional dance forms, including **Yakshagana**, which is a blend of **dance, music, and drama.**

 
 
• Other popular dances from Karnataka include** Dollu Kunitha**, a percussion-based dance, and **Kamsale**, which involves the use of metallic discs as musical instruments.
 
 
 
• **Andhra Pradesh** is known for its classical dance forms such as **Kuchipudi and Vilasini Natyam.**
 
 
• Folk dances from the state include** Dappu,** a percussion-based dance, and** Lambadi**, a tribal dance form.
 
 
 
• **Tamil Nadu** has several classical dance forms, including** Bharatanatyam and Koothu.**
 
 
• Folk dances from the state include **Karagattam**, a dance involving balancing pots on the head, and **Mayil Attam**, a peacock dance.
